title: Claude Opus 4.7
raw_excerpt: Anthropic has released Claude Opus 4.7, offering improved performance on difficult engineering tasks, stronger vision capabilities, and more reliable long-running task execution compared to its predecessor.
summary: Anthropic 发布了 Claude Opus 4.7，在困难工程任务、视觉能力和长任务执行可靠性上相比前代有显著提升。该模型是 Anthropic 目前最强大的旗舰模型，直接对标 OpenAI 的 GPT-4 系列，对 AI 编程、多模态理解和复杂推理场景具有重要影响。

title: OpenAI's GPT Rosalind
raw_excerpt: OpenAI introduced GPT‑Rosalind, a specialized model designed to support drug discovery and biological research through improved reasoning, tool use, and integration with scientific data sources.
summary: OpenAI 推出 GPT-Rosalind，一个专为药物发现和生物学研究设计的专用模型。该模型通过改进的推理能力、工具使用和与科学数据源的集成，旨在加速生物医学研究。这标志着 AI 模型从通用向垂直科学领域的深度定制迈出重要一步。

title: OpenAI to spend more than $20 billion on Cerebras chips, receive stake, The Information reports
raw_excerpt: OpenAI will pay Cerebras more than $20 billion over the next three years to use servers powered by Cerebras' chips. The deal may also give OpenAI an equity stake in Cerebras. OpenAI has also agreed to provide Cerebras with about $1 billion to help fund the development of data centers. Cerebras is targeting an IPO in the second quarter of this year.
summary: 据 The Information 报道，OpenAI 将在未来三年向芯片公司 Cerebras 支付超过 200 亿美元，用于使用其服务器，并可能获得 Cerebras 股权。同时 OpenAI 还将提供约 10 亿美元帮助其建设数据中心。这一巨额投资反映了 AI 算力需求的爆发式增长，以及 OpenAI 对非英伟达芯片生态的战略布局。

title: Codex for (almost) everything
raw_excerpt: The updated Codex app for macOS and Windows adds computer use, in-app browsing, image generation, memory, and plugins to accelerate developer workflows.
summary: OpenAI 发布了更新版 Codex 应用（macOS 和 Windows），新增计算机使用、应用内浏览、图像生成、记忆和插件功能，旨在加速开发者工作流。Codex 从单纯的代码补全工具进化为全能开发助手，对 AI 辅助编程领域具有里程碑意义。

title: Introducing Ternary Bonsai: Top Intelligence at 1.58 Bits
raw_excerpt: Ternary Bonsai is a 1.58-bit language model family offering improved performance with minimal memory usage. It outperforms 1-bit counterparts, scoring 75.5 on average benchmarks and achieving 3-4x better energy efficiency. The models, available in 8B, 4B, and 1.7B versions, provide flexible deployment across devices like Macs and iPhones under the Apache 2.0 License.
summary: Prism ML 发布了 Ternary Bonsai 模型家族，采用 1.58 位量化技术，在极低内存占用下实现 75.5 的平均基准分数，能效比提升 3-4 倍。提供 8B、4B 和 1.7B 三种规模，可在 Mac 和 iPhone 上部署，Apache 2.0 开源。这为端侧 AI 部署提供了新的高效方案。

title: Qwen 3.6 and Agentic Coding (GitHub Repo)
raw_excerpt: Qwen 3.6 introduces stronger repository-level reasoning and front-end workflow handling, along with a thinking preservation feature that maintains context across iterations.
summary: Qwen 3.6 发布，增强了仓库级推理和前端工作流处理能力，并引入跨迭代保持上下文的思考保留功能。该模型在代码生成和 agentic 编程场景中表现突出，是开源社区在编程 AI 领域的重要进展。

title: Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS: the next generation of expressive AI speech
raw_excerpt: Google's Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS enhances text-to-speech with improved expressivity and controllability, featuring a notable Elo score of 1,211 on the Artificial Analysis TTS leaderboard. The model supports over 70 languages and introduces audio tags for granular control of vocal style, allowing easy manipulation via natural language commands. All generated audio is watermarked with SynthID to ensure authentic content, preventing misinformation.
summary: Google 推出 Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS，在 Artificial Analysis TTS 排行榜上获得 1211 的 Elo 评分，支持 70 多种语言，并通过音频标签实现精细的语音风格控制。所有生成音频均使用 SynthID 水印，防止滥用。该模型显著提升了 AI 语音合成的表现力和可控性。

title: Why Fine-Tuning Encourages Hallucinations and How to Fix It
raw_excerpt:
作者: Guy Kaplan, Zorik Gekhman, Zhen Zhu, Lotem Rozner, Yuval Reif, Swabha Swayamdipta, Derek Hoiem, Roy Schwartz
摘要: Large language models are prone to hallucinating factually incorrect statements. A key source of these errors is exposure to new factual information through supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which can increase hallucinations w.r.t. knowledge acquired during pre-training. In this work, we explore whether SFT-induced hallucinations can be mitigated using established tools from the continual learning literature, since they arise as a by-product of knowledge degradation during training. We propose a self-distillation-based SFT method that facilitates effective factual learning while minimizing hallucinations w.r.t. pre-existing knowledge by regularizing output-distribution drift. We also show that, in settings where new knowledge acquisition is unnecessary, suppressing factual plasticity by freezing parameter groups, can preserve task performance while reducing hallucinations. Lastly, we investigate the mechanism behind SFT-induced hallucinations through three hypotheses: capacity limitations, behavior cloning, and localized interference. Our experiments show that a main driver is interference among overlapping semantic representations, and that self-distillation succeeds by mitigating this interference.
summary: 这篇论文揭示了监督微调（SFT）导致大模型幻觉增加的根本原因——新事实知识的引入会破坏预训练阶段获得的知识。作者利用持续学习技术来缓解这一问题，为提升模型可靠性提供了理论依据和实用方法。

title: Parcae: Doing more with fewer parameters using stable looped models
raw_excerpt: Parcae is one of the first stable architectures for looped language models. It achieves the quality of a Transformer twice the size with clean, predictable training. Parcae increases the recurrence rather than purely scaling data, creating a new medium to scale quality. The name Parcae is a homage to the three Roman fates: Nona, Decima, and Morta.
summary: Together AI 发布 Parcae，首个稳定的循环语言模型架构。该模型通过增加循环次数而非单纯扩大数据规模来提升质量，在参数量减半的情况下达到两倍规模 Transformer 的性能。这为语言模型的高效扩展提供了新范式。

title: Jane Street commits $6 billion to CoreWeave and takes a $1 billion equity stake
raw_excerpt: Jane Street is betting that the returns on AI-driven trading will justify $6 billion in cloud spending and a $1 billion equity position in the company providing it.
summary: 量化交易巨头 Jane Street 向云服务商 CoreWeave 承诺 60 亿美元云支出，并收购其 10 亿美元股权。这一举动表明金融行业对 AI 驱动交易回报的强烈信心，也反映了 AI 算力市场的巨大需求和资本密集度。
